vectors.name: defaults-omitted
vectors.description: No optional input: reserve 50 bps, minimum leg value 1.00 USD, no deposit, no token to exit.

vectors.name: two-tokens-default-reserve
vectors.description: An 8-decimal token at 1,250.00 USD and an 18-decimal token at 0.50 USD. The buy is capped by the reserve.

vectors.name: rounding-steps
vectors.description: Prices and balances that do not divide: every rounding step of valuation, targets, sell and buy is visible.

vectors.name: first-replication-20-usd
vectors.description: 20 USDC into three tokens of 8, 18 and 6 decimals. Buys are scaled to the budget.

vectors.name: single-constituent
vectors.description: An index with one constituent at 10,000 bps.

vectors.name: equal-64-deposit-10000-usd
vectors.description: 64 equal-weighted constituents, buy only, a deposit of 10,000 USD and no reserve.

vectors.name: blocked-first-replication-64-below-minimum
vectors.description: 20 USD into 64 constituents: every buy is below the minimum leg value, so the first replication is blocked with the deployable value that is enough.

vectors.name: blocked-first-replication-90-10
vectors.description: 9 USDC into 90/10 with every default: the buy of the 10% constituent is below 1.00 USD.

vectors.name: first-replication-at-the-stated-minimum
vectors.description: The same index with the minimum of the previous vector, rounded up to a quote base unit: both constituents are bought.

vectors.name: on-target-deposit-with-a-skipped-buy
vectors.description: A wallet on target at 90/10 and a deposit of 10 USD: one buy is below the minimum. The capped candidate buys nothing and keeps the drift at 0, the uncapped one would take it to 472 bps. The idle deposit is reported.

vectors.name: due-rebalance-with-a-skipped-buy
vectors.description: 50/40/0 USD against 1/98/1 with every default: the smallest buy is skipped, and the rebalance still takes the drift from 5456 to 101 bps.

vectors.name: tie-in-drift-with-a-deposit
vectors.description: 5,000 USD against 9999/1 and a deposit of 5,000 USD: both candidates end 1 bps off. The call carries a deposit, so the candidate that invests it is returned.

vectors.name: tie-in-drift-without-a-deposit
vectors.description: The same wallet with the 5,000 USDC as quote balance and no deposit: the candidate that trades less is returned, and the idle amount is reported.

vectors.name: tie-in-drift-with-a-deposit-below-one-quote-unit
vectors.description: The wallet of tie-in-drift-without-a-deposit with a deposit of 99 in USD E8, less than one quote base unit: it adds nothing to the funds, is no deposit for the tie, and the result is that of the call without a deposit.

vectors.name: capped-candidate-sells-for-its-own-buys
vectors.description: Seven constituents with whole-unit and 2-decimal tokens, no deposit: two buys are skipped as zero_quantity and the capped candidate is returned on a tie. Its sells are scaled to what its capped buys spend, so the proceeds are spent and only rounding is left on top of the reserve.

vectors.name: both-candidates-raise-drift
vectors.description: A buy-only plan over ten constituents where a whole-unit token cannot be bought: both candidates end further from target than the wallet is, the smaller increase is returned and reported.

vectors.name: buy-capped-at-target-weight
vectors.description: Two buys are below the minimum and the third is capped at its target weight of the projected invested value.

vectors.name: sell-scaled-to-the-buys
vectors.description: A buy is below the minimum, so the sell is reduced to the proceeds the remaining buy spends. The cap does not bind.

vectors.name: sell-raised-to-the-minimum
vectors.description: A scaled sell of 8.30 USD is raised to the minimum of 9.00 USD. Of the two candidates the uncapped one has the lower projected drift (135 against 155 bps).

vectors.name: sell-not-needed
vectors.description: Every buy is below the minimum, so the sell that would fund them is not proposed.

vectors.name: buy-spends-what-its-quantity-costs
vectors.description: A whole-unit token at 1,250.00 USD and 1,999 USDC: one unit is bought for 1,250 USDC.

vectors.name: first-replication-drift-warning
vectors.description: Three quote base units into 60/40 buy one base unit of each token: the projected drift is compared against zero and reported.

vectors.name: exit-skipped-is-not-deployable
vectors.description: A token to exit worth less than the minimum is not sold and does not raise any target.

vectors.name: ten-million-usd
vectors.description: Four constituents worth 10,000,304.50 USD: one sell funds three scaled buys.

vectors.name: buy-only-deposit
vectors.description: A deposit into a drifted wallet in buy-only mode: nothing is sold and drift remains.

vectors.name: exit-removed-constituent
vectors.description: A token removed in the target version is sold in full. Another token outside the index is left alone.

vectors.name: minimum-leg-skips
vectors.description: A sell and a buy of 2.00 USD under a minimum of 5.00 USD: both skipped, drift unchanged.

vectors.name: minimum-leg-cascade
vectors.description: 45/28/27 USD against 40/30/30 with a minimum of 3.00 USD: the buy of 2.00 USD is skipped, and the sell is reduced to the 3.00 USD the other buy spends.

vectors.name: whole-unit-token
vectors.description: A token with 0 decimals at 1,000.00 USD: an excess of 500 USD is less than one unit, so nothing is sold and nothing is bought.

vectors.name: warnings-last-close-and-delayed
vectors.description: A last_close price and a delayed price are warnings and the plan is computed.

vectors.name: blocked-last-close-option
vectors.description: The same input with blockOnLastClose: the last_close price is a blocker and there is no plan.

vectors.name: blocked-missing-and-unavailable-price
vectors.description: One constituent has no price and one has an unavailable price.

vectors.name: blocked-zero-price
vectors.description: A price of zero is a blocker.

vectors.name: blocked-decimals-mismatch
vectors.description: A holding reports 8 decimals for a constituent recorded with 6.

vectors.name: blocked-zero-deployable-value
vectors.description: No constituent, no quote asset and no deposit.

vectors.name: blocked-price-without-status
vectors.description: A price with no status is not a value: the constituent is unavailable.

vectors.name: blocked-price-with-unknown-status
vectors.description: A status that is not one of the four classes is read as unavailable.

vectors.name: warning-projected-drift-increase
vectors.description: A buy-only plan cannot sell five constituents above target; the pro rata buys leave the largest constituent 367 bps under target, up from a maximum of 200 bps, and both numbers are reported.

vectors.name: reserve-zero-minimum-zero-on-target
vectors.description: 60/40 USD against 50/50 with no reserve and no minimum: one sell and one buy bring the wallet exactly on target.

vectors.name: reserve-at-maximum
vectors.description: A deposit of 1,000 USD into 50/50 with the largest reserve, 2,000 bps: the buys spend 80% of the funds and 200 USDC stay uninvested.

vectors.name: reserve-limits-buys-not-sells
vectors.description: 70/30 USD against 50/50 with a reserve of 1,000 bps: the full sell of 20 USD funds a buy of 18 USD, and the 2 USDC kept back leave 102 bps of drift.

vectors.name: minimum-zero-proposes-cent-legs
vectors.description: 50.03/49.97 USD against 50/50 with a minimum of zero: a sell and a buy of about 0.03 USD are proposed.

vectors.name: dust-holdings-are-a-first-replication
vectors.description: The wallet holds 1,000 base units of an 18-decimal token, valued at zero: the invested value is zero and 50 USDC are a first replication.

vectors.name: dust-quote-below-a-leg-is-nothing-to-do
vectors.description: A wallet on target with 0.40 USDC of quote asset: both buys it could fund are below the minimum and are skipped, so nothing is proposed.

vectors.name: exit-ignored-in-buy-only
vectors.description: A token to exit is listed in buy-only mode: it is not sold and not counted as deployable.

vectors.name: exit-with-last-close-price
vectors.description: The price of a token to exit is last_close: it is a warning, and the token is sold in full at that reference price.

vectors.name: blocked-exit-without-price
vectors.description: A token to exit that the wallet holds has no price: its value is unknown, so there is no plan.

vectors.name: blocked-exit-on-last-close-option
vectors.description: The input of exit-with-last-close-price with blockOnLastClose: the price of the token to exit is a blocker.

vectors.name: exit-listed-but-not-held
vectors.description: A token to exit with a balance of zero and no price is not sold and does not block the plan.

vectors.name: two-exits-one-below-minimum
vectors.description: Two tokens to exit: one worth 25.00 USD is sold in full, the other worth 0.60 USD is below the minimum and stays.

vectors.name: exit-and-deposit
vectors.description: A token to exit worth 30 USD and a deposit of 70 USD fund a new two-constituent version from scratch.

vectors.name: deposit-with-a-fraction-of-a-quote-unit
vectors.description: A deposit of 123.45678901 USD counts as 123.456789 USDC: the fraction of a quote base unit is not deployable.

vectors.name: inputs-in-descending-order
vectors.description: Constituents, holdings and prices listed in descending token order: legs, targets and skips are still in ascending order, sells first.

vectors.name: high-price-whole-units
vectors.description: 500 USDC into a token at 100,000.00 USD with 8 decimals and one at 0.0001 USD with 18 decimals: each buy spends 248.75 USDC.

vectors.name: two-decimal-token-rounding
vectors.description: A 2-decimal token at 33.33 USD and a 6-decimal token at 0.07 USD: quantities, costs and proceeds round in the stated directions.

vectors.name: buy-only-on-target-nothing-to-do
vectors.description: A buy-only plan for a wallet on target without quote asset: no leg, and the result says there is nothing to do.

vectors.name: buy-only-deposit-larger-than-shortfall
vectors.description: A buy-only deposit of 100 USD into a wallet 10 USD short of target: every constituent is bought to its target share of the larger value.

vectors.name: rebalance-64-constituents-drifted
vectors.description: 64 equal-weighted constituents, alternately holding 130 USD and 70 USD, in rebalance mode: 32 sells fund 32 buys and the drift goes from 47 bps to 0.

vectors.name: delayed-exit-and-constituent
vectors.description: A delayed price on a constituent and on a token to exit: two warnings, and the plan is computed at those prices.

vectors.name: deposit-larger-than-the-drift-needs-no-sell
vectors.description: 80/20 USD with a deposit of 1,000 USD in rebalance mode: both constituents are below their new target value, so nothing is sold and the deposit funds two buys.
